description: The types of object that can be subscribed.
name: SubscriptionObjectType

enum.name: FORUM
enum.description: A discussion forum that users can subscribe to for updates.

enum.name: THREAD
enum.description: A discussion thread within a forum that users can subscribe to for updates.

enum.name: DATA_ACCESS_SUBMISSION
enum.description: A submission for requesting access to data, which users can subscribe to for status updates.

enum.name: DATA_ACCESS_SUBMISSION_STATUS
enum.description: The status of a data access submission, which users can subscribe to for notifications about changes.
